description: Figure 4.1 (second row, first plot) illustrates how WER changes over fine-tuning epochs for the Whisper model of type “small,” with multiple lines corresponding to different weight/initialization conditions shown in the legend. The x-axis is labeled “epoch,” uses a linear scale, and runs from 0 to 6 with integer tick marks at each epoch. The y-axis is labeled “WER,” uses a linear scale, and spans approximately from 25 to 42.5, with labeled ticks at regular 2.5-unit intervals (25, 27.5, 30, …, 42.5). Four orange lines are plotted with circular markers connected by solid line segments: one line starts near 35 at epoch 0, rises to about 40 at epoch 1 and peaks around 42 at epoch 2, then declines to roughly 31 by epoch 6; a second line begins around 30 at epoch 0 and decreases gradually to about 25 by epoch 6; a third line starts near 35 at epoch 0, drops to about 33–34 by epochs 1–2, then continues downward to roughly 25–26 by epoch 6; and a fourth line begins around 30 at epoch 0, stays near 30 at epoch 1, then trends downward to about 25 by epoch 6.
